title: Roadmap sprint gateways and exec storyboards - QBR prep & monthly synthesis
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Create a repeatable runbook and a compact executive storyboard set that converts roadmap work-in-progress into board- and exec-ready narrative. The package ties sprint-level gating decisions to financial & latency OKRs, highlights risk lanes, and provides concrete decision asks (funding, resource reallocation, rollback triggers).

Scope: 1) Define sprint gateways (criteria + owners) that determine whether an initiative advances from 'Triage/Discovery' -> 'Planned' -> 'Execution' -> 'Canary' -> 'GA'. 2) Produce a 6-slide exec storyboard template and a 1-page decision ask for each initiative in the upcoming QBR. 3) Build a lightweight stakeholder signaling cadence (who signs off, reviewer SLA, fallback path). 4) Hook the package to runtime metrics (latency p95, cost per 1k tokens, error rate) and initiative health dashboards for live QBR demos.
acceptance_criteria: Sprint gateway definitions documented with pass/fail criteria and an assigned owner for each gate
Exec storyboard template (6 slides) accepted by GTM and Eng leads
1-page decision ask created for top-6 initiatives with clear funding/resource asks and rollback criteria
Live demo wired to metrics dashboard (runtime-p95, cost/unit, error-rate) for QBR rehearsal
Stakeholder signal cadence documented and an opt-in list for reviewers with response SLAs
